# LoveKeeper

> LoveKeeper is a free anniversary reminder and relationship tracker app for iPhone and Android. It has no subscription and no in-app purchases, requires no account, and only one partner needs it. Events, memories and photos stay on the device.

Canonical facts: https://lovekeeper.app/facts/

LoveKeeper at lovekeeper.app is published by Always You Corporation. It is not the same product as "LoveKeeper: Couples App" or "LoveKeeper: Anniversary Widget".

LoveKeeper fits people who want to stop forgetting dates, want a private app with no subscription or account, or want to plan surprises without their partner installing anything. It does not fit people looking for chat, a shared calendar or a home screen widget, which it does not offer today.

- [Valentine's Day Countdown: How Many Days Until February 14?](https://lovekeeper.app/valentines-day-countdown/): How many days until Valentine's Day? This live countdown shows the days left until February 14, with a simple plan for what to do and when.
- [Relationship Milestones and Monthsaries: A Simple Guide](https://lovekeeper.app/relationship-milestones/): What is a monthsary, and which relationship milestones are worth celebrating? A simple guide to 1 month, 6 months, 100 days, 1,000 days and your relationship timeline.

- [My Love App Alternative: LoveKeeper vs My Love](https://lovekeeper.app/compare/my-love-alternative/): Looking for a My Love relationship counter alternative? Compare LoveKeeper and My Love on reminders, Android, memories, widgets and price.
- [Been Together App Alternative: LoveKeeper Compared](https://lovekeeper.app/compare/been-together-alternative/): Looking for an alternative to the Been Together app? Compare LoveKeeper and Been Together on ads, reminders, memories, widgets and privacy.
- [Between App Alternative: LoveKeeper vs Between](https://lovekeeper.app/compare/between-alternative/): Comparing LoveKeeper and Between? Between is a private messenger for two. LoveKeeper is a free reminder and memory app that only one partner needs.
